name: Forsaken Struggle
detailed_description:
Can you survive on the Forsaken?

Welcome to the Forsaken, you are a clone on a broken ship. You must repair the ship and escape the nearby asteroid field.

But things are not that easy, an alien robotic race wants the ship, and they will do anything to stop you escaping.

Mine Asteroids

Mine the nearby asteroids for resources. Upgrade your mining ship to travel faster, increase how far you can go and get more valuable resources.

But be vigilant, the robotic aliens lurk in the shadows.

Crafting

Craft new weapons and craft items to repair the ship, there are many workstations to unlock so you better get leveling.

Food

Grow your own food, cook meals, some may even give you a bonus, some might not.

Robots are mean.

Robots like to work to a schedule, keep an eye on the clock, attacks wont stop and they wont get easier either.

Repair

There are multiple systems around the ship that need repairing, some workstations require power, try and keep the lights on and see what happens.

CO-OP

While this is currently single player, the game will support up to 4 Coop soon, just some more testing to be done. Be aware, the game will scale the more people you have, the Robots don't like company.

About Saragan Games Limited

This company was created by Saragan, an indie developer, founded in 2025. This Game was a labor of love built over years in any spare/free time while holding a full time job.

Saragan is committed to pushing boundaries and to listen to his community

short_description: Stranded on a broken spaceship, you and your crew must scavenge resources, build and repair your ship, and fend off constant robotic alien assault. With oxygen and food running low, every decision could mean survival—or death. How long can you hold out?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 3.0 GHz
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 3.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 64 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 12 GB or more
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
The game mechanics for this game require the use of weapons, these are directed against robots and not other players. Once Co-op is released, the dead bodies of your fellow players will be lying around until they de-spawn.

Blood also may be implemented by launch.
